info.title: IT Service Desk and Incident Ticketing System API
info.description: Final 33-endpoint contract derived from Baseline v6.0 plus the approved Q03 change. UTC ISO 8601. Request models reject additional fields unless stated. Required response fields are always present; unavailable or role-hidden values are JSON null. Every operation contains a successful frontend mock example.
